description: This header file defines constants, macros, and inline functions related to the Nordic Semiconductor nRF52 radio hardware simulation, including timing parameters, power levels, and radio mode configurations for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) PHYs.

methods.name: hal_radio_reset
methods.description: Resets the radio hardware simulation (empty implementation).

methods.name: hal_radio_stop
methods.description: Stops the radio hardware simulation (empty implementation).

methods.name: hal_radio_ram_prio_setup
methods.description: Sets up radio RAM priority (empty implementation).

methods.name: hal_radio_phy_mode_get
methods.description: Returns the radio mode based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_floor
methods.description: Returns closest supported power level at or below the given level.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns transmit ready delay in microseconds based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns receive ready delay in microseconds based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns transmit chain delay in microseconds.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns receive chain delay in microseconds based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns transmit ready delay in nanoseconds based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns receive ready delay in nanoseconds based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns transmit chain delay in nanoseconds.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns receive chain delay in nanoseconds based on PHY.
